# v1.3.1

## Fixes & improvements

- Added a warning for when the everything is disabled or you can afford pity on everything, so every possible move is a tie and the optimizer gives moot results
- fixed an issue where the new serca books prices are set to 0 (instead of the 15000 default, while the market price is unavailable)
- scanner no longer loads on mobile
- optimizer should be a lot faster by virtue of choosing better starting points
